notes.title: Alternate Costumes Now Available!
notes.notes:
Announcing for the first time ever, cosmetic DLC for Lust Knight Lisa! If you wanted to mix things up or needed an excuse to play through the game again, this is the perfect opportunity to do so! You can change the costume at any time you can access the "Options" menu in this latest update!

[list]
[*]"Warm Milk" Cow Print Bikini - Comes with a special, costume specific variant for the titty suck fetish effect.
[*]"Easter Bunny" Reverse Bunny Suit - Just in time for Easter! Comes with a special, costume specific variant for the sealed fetish effect.
[*]"Sexy Cure" Magical Girl outfit - Super duper magical lust power! Comes with a special, costume specific variant for the webbed (arms and legs) fetish effect.
[/list]

Check out the store pages for screenshots and more details!

notes.title: Lust Knight Lisa NOW ON STEAM!
notes.notes:
Lust Knight Lisa is now available on Steam! Pick it up today to travel through twelve unique and kinky areas that will put Lisa into all kinds of kinky predicaments both in battle and outside of it! Train during the day while juggling office work, then fight at night against the consequences of your earlier decisions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504770/Lust_Knight_Lisa/

Oh, and if the game is feeling a little on the tough side, check out this handy Community Guide that Luvjak made to help out all of those struggling Lust Knights:
